look.description: Cosmetic: the fighter's three paint colors, as `rrggbb.rrggbb.rrggbb` (body, trim, gloves). The sim never sees it.

build.description: The fighter's build: twelve points at most over four stats of 1–5, and a special. It changes the sim, so a verifier replaying a ghost fight uses exactly this.

style.description: How the CPU plays this fighter when it's a ghost: a rusher closes in and swings, a turtle blocks and punishes, a zoner keeps range and throws, a tricky one jumps, sweeps and dashes.

main.description: A player's fighter, published into their own repo so anyone can fight its ghost: the build the sim uses, the style the CPU plays it in, and the paint it wears. One per account, at rkey `self`; saving again overwrites it. A ghost run pins the version it fought by CID, so overwriting changes no old result.
